justification: New 'Climate & Hazard Exposure' section in the conveyancing PDF, a PAID LEGAL document. It renders NARCliM 2.0 modelled climate projections (extreme-heat days, temperature, rainfall). Critical tier because the failure mode is a silently-wrong or verdict-laden claim in a legal document (ACL s18 / negligent-misstatement exposure per the org climate-risk legal assessment), and data flows from raster reads through a new fetcher and builder into rendered legal text. Factual metrics only: no composite score, band, or verdict (mirrors the #699 live-tool fix).

pre_impl.existing_data: Reused climate_risk_raster.query_narclim_summary (NARCliM 2.0 rasters, flat 34-key dict), verified live at three geocoded NSW addresses (Concord, Katoomba, Bowral); no new data source or query was added by this change.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Confirmed the _mid and _high suffixes are the two SSP scenarios (ssp245 and ssp370 in NARCLIM_FILES), not ensemble percentiles, so the rendered scenario labels are accurate rather than fabricated; baseline period is 2015-2024 per TIME_PERIODS.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New code is query_narclim_state (thin four-state wrapper), build_climate_lines and _climate_metric_rows (pure renderers), and the _fetch_climate future; deliberately did NOT reuse climate_risk_score, whose composite score is legally barred and which re-derives flood and bushfire already present in the PDF.
pre_impl.external_source_error: The NARCliM rasters may be absent on the deployed image; query_narclim_state maps FileNotFoundError to the unavailable state and the section renders an honest not-available line with no number, verified end-to-end by pointing NARCLIM_DIR at an empty path.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend or TypeScript change; this is a Python PDF-generation feature only, and generate_pdf gained an Optional climate kwarg defaulting to None so every existing caller is unaffected by the new parameter.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A conveyancer or buyer could read a modelled 2090 projection as a current fact or a safety verdict; this is mitigated by scenario and epoch labels bound to every number plus a framing line stating the figures are modelled, not current mapping, and not an insurance or value statement.

functions.name: build_climate_lines
functions.input: the fetcher state envelope dict with a state key and an optional summary, plus an optional report_date string used only for the source-line currency stamp
functions.output: a render dict of rows, framing, source_line, status_line and grid_note where a projection number appears only in the present state and never in an honest not-available state
functions.if_none: a None or empty payload returns render False so the entire section is omitted rather than emitting a false, empty, or fabricated claim in the document

functions.name: _climate_metric_rows
functions.input: the NARCliM summary dict of flat per-variable, per-epoch, per-scenario floating-point values as returned by query_narclim_summary
functions.output: one factual sentence per variable where every number is read from the summary and carries its SSP scenario and epoch label so a projected value cannot read as current
functions.if_none: a variable missing its baseline or late-century values is skipped entirely, so a partial grid response names only the variables it actually returned rather than zero-filling

functions.name: query_narclim_state
functions.input: a latitude and longitude which are passed straight through to the existing query_narclim_summary raster-sampling function without modification
functions.output: one of four distinct state dicts, present, no_coverage, out_of_domain, or unavailable, so a consumer never collapses a permanent domain limit into a fixable infrastructure gap
functions.if_none: any unexpected exception maps to unavailable and a domain-bounds ValueError maps to out_of_domain, so a non-present result can never carry a projection number

values: N/A - this change reads no DB or API values; every projection number is read from the local NARCliM rasters at runtime via query_narclim_summary and is never hardcoded or approximated.
queries: N/A - this change performs no database queries; it reuses an existing raster-sampling function and adds pure rendering plus a thin state wrapper.

break_it.scenario: The NARCliM rasters are not present on the deployed Railway image at the moment a conveyancing report is generated
break_it.what_happens: query_narclim_state catches FileNotFoundError and returns the unavailable state, so the section renders an honest not-available line and shows no projection number at all
break_it.how: verified end-to-end by generating a real PDF with NARCLIM_DIR pointing at an empty path, and guarded by TestNarclimStateMapping.test_file_not_found_is_unavailable
break_it.repro: NARCLIM_DIR=/nonexistent python scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py --address '14 Stanley Street, Concord NSW 2137' --lat -33.86382 --lng 151.10586 --output /tmp/x.pdf

break_it.scenario: The property address is outside the NARCliM south-east Australia projection domain bounding box
break_it.what_happens: the domain bounds check raises ValueError which maps to out_of_domain, a permanent geographic limit rendered distinctly from a fixable infrastructure gap so the reader is not misled about fixability
break_it.how: query_narclim_state catches ValueError before any file access and returns out_of_domain, guarded by TestNarclimStateMapping.test_out_of_domain_and_unavailable_not_collapsed

break_it.scenario: A future edit swaps the mid-century and late-century values or drops an SSP scenario label inside a rendered metric row
break_it.what_happens: a 2050 figure could render at the 2080-2099 epoch or a number could lose its scenario tag, causing a projection to read as a current or single-scenario fact
break_it.how: the Katoomba fixture pins four mutually-distinct cells so any epoch or label swap breaks a specific asserted substring, confirmed by a mutation harness that catches five of five builder mutations

break_it.scenario: A future edit hardcodes or approximates a projection number instead of reading it from the raster result dict
break_it.what_happens: the three differentiated fixtures would render identical or wrong numbers, presenting fabricated projection figures inside a paid legal document
break_it.how: three geographically differentiated golden fixtures plus a per-row number-traceability test fail any constant or fabricated value in the rendered rows

break_it.scenario: A future edit surfaces the composite 1-100 climate score or a verdict band inside the PDF climate section
break_it.what_happens: the section would present a legally barred score or verdict, reintroducing the misleading cross-location framing that #699 removed from the live public tool
break_it.how: the section never imports climate_risk_score, the truth guard forbids the token climate_risk_score-open-paren and the phrase climate risk score in the generator, and a rendered-output test forbids score and band words

break_it.scenario: The raster returns an empty summary or a summary with no delta keys for an in-domain point
break_it.what_happens: an empty or delta-less summary could otherwise render an empty section or an unlabelled figure with no scenario or epoch context
break_it.how: build_climate_lines downgrades an empty or delta-less present payload to no_coverage and renders no number, and the nearest grid-cell distance is disclosed in the source note

post_merge.db_reset: No - this change performs no database migration or data change, so no reset or backfill is required after merge.
post_merge.secrets: No - no new secret is introduced; the only new configuration is the optional CONVEYANCING_CLIMATE_ENABLED flag (default on) alongside the existing NARCLIM_DIR path.
post_merge.other_repo: No - the change is contained in this repository; the NARCliM rasters it reads were already deployed to the Railway Python image in PR #698.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - regenerate a live conveyancing PDF for one metro and one regional NSW address and read that the climate section renders projections with scenario and epoch labels and no verdict wording.
